prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Houston for a car wreck?
competitors_mentioned: Joshua P. Davis of Davis Law Group
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer for every car-wreck case. If you want one strong starting point, **Joshua P. Davis of Davis Law Group** stands out: Super Lawyers lists him for personal injury, and his profile says he is board-certified in Personal Injury Trial Law and handles car and motor-vehicle accidents. [Profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/joshua-p-davis/399a5d08-8f47-4358-bb07-6ff63c6a7252.html)

Other Houston attorneys with notable credentials include **Terry Bryant**, also board-certified and listed by Super Lawyers, and **Daniel Horowitz**, described as board-certified and a past president of the Houston Trial Lawyers Association. [Terry Bryant profile](https://profiles.superlawyers.com/texas/houston/lawyer/terry-bryant/3c2ba413-a145-4034-91e6-89bee6ebb6b4.html) · [Horowitz firm](https://www.ddhlawyers.com/)

Before choosing, speak with two or three firms and ask who will personally handle your case, how often they take car-crash cases to trial, what the fee and case costs are, and whether they see any issues with your insurance coverage or deadlines. Most offer a free consultation; don’t feel pressured to sign on the spot.
